name: F1 Live (OpenF1)
description: Polls the public OpenF1 REST API for live session lap data.

name: TCP Generic Feed
description: Connects to a raw TCP socket and reads line-delimited timing data. Format parsing is a stub — see adapter_tcp.js TODO.

name: Supercars Live Feed
description: Connects to the official Supercars Championship TCP timing stream (binary-framed XML protocol). Driver colours are saved to config/drivers_v8sc.json.

name: Replay (local file)
description: Replays a previously saved session JSON file at configurable speed.
